1. **Diagnosed the issue** — the latest deploy (v2.3.1) was failing health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

3. **Verified recovery** — all three regions are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api. The creation call timed out, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was created successfully (open status) rather than risk a duplicate.

No approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
